description: MIND Budget — 13-week cash-flow planner at m-i-n-d.ai/#/budget. Actions: overview, set_cells, set_starting, set_rows, row_create, row_update, row_delete, rows_reorder, row_cancel, row_restore, set_goals, set_quarter, variance, roll_forward, autofill_from_statement, autofill_accept, build_from_statements, build_accept, automanage_health.

align_to_statement.description: Align cells to statement dates — build_from_statements (default true).

apply.description: Apply the autofill immediately — autofill_from_statement (default false).

carry_ending.description: Carry the previous quarter's ending balance forward — set_quarter (default true).

create_next.description: Create the next quarter — roll_forward (default true).

from_week.description: Week index 0-12 to cancel from — row_cancel (defaults to current week).

label.description: Row label — required for row_create; row_update.

label_text.description: Quarter label, e.g. 'Q1 2027' — set_quarter. Maps to the REST body field 'label'.

proposal.description: The full BuildProposal object returned by build_from_statements — required for build_accept.

proposal_ids.description: Which autofill proposals to accept — autofill_accept (empty = accept all).

rows.description: [{id?, label, group: 'receipt'|'paidout'|'paidout2', order}] — set_rows (replaces the whole row set).

starting_cents.description: Starting cash balance in cents — required for set_starting.

threshold_pct.description: Variance alert threshold percent — variance (server default 20).

transactions.description: [{date, amount?, amount_cents?, merchant?, description?, category?, direction?}] — autofill_from_statement/build_from_statements.

name: mind_budget
